gate: n_eff > 2.0 required before claiming quorum value

five_vendor_matrix_2026_08_04.mechanism: Correlation tracks ERROR RATE, not vendor. falcon3 has the lowest error (0.51) AND the lowest mean correlation to every other leg (0.323). qwen2.5 is mid-error but the most correlated (0.556), so DROPPING it raises n_eff from 1.79 to 1.88 — a leg can make the quorum worse. Legs that are wrong on most items are wrong on the SAME items, whoever trained them.
five_vendor_matrix_2026_08_04.path_to_the_gate: Two levers, both cheap and neither requiring a new architecture. (1) More legs relaxes the requirement: k=3 needs phi_bar<0.250, k=8 needs <0.429, and we already measure 0.447 — so eight decent legs is close, where three can never get there. (2) Prefer LOW-ERROR legs and drop high-correlating ones. The SSM in task #18 is worth testing but is not the only route, and on this evidence not the most reliable one.
